messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — the int8 canary on raven-v3 is showing ~0.9% tool-call failures due to JSON parse errors. Seems correlated with unusual whitespace/newline patterns inside the token stream.

maria: Posting a redacted example output we saw in logs: 
```
{"action": "update", "params": {"id": 123,\n\t"payload": "{\"name\": \"Acme\", \n\\u2028\"notes\": \"line1\nline2\"}"}}
```

maria: Note the U+2028 (line separator) and embedded raw literal newline inside a value — JSON.parse fails in our strict parser.

sam: Oof. Is that coming from the model emitting literal control chars or from tokenization/decoding?

maria: Hard to tell yet. We observed higher error rates when kv-prefixing long system prompts and when prefix end aligns to subword boundary. Hypothesis: decoding produces an extra 0xE2 0x80 0xA8 sequence (U+2028) occasionally in int8 quant paths.

anya-qa: Repro notes: repro rate goes up on short beam lengths + aggressive sampling. I ran a small batch where we force-emit a JSON block and saw the same separator in ~1/200 responses.

sam: Can you attach a minimal repro script? Also add a telemetry tag with decode_trace so we can surface token boundaries.

maria: Pasted a tiny repro curl that calls the canary and writes raw bytes: 
```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://canary.redwood/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $CANARY' \
  -d '{"prompt":"prefix: <KV>...","max_tokens":64,"temperature":0.9}' > out.raw
xxd out.raw | head -n 12
```

maria: I put samples in S3 with prefix s3://redwood-internal/canary/raven-v3/whitespace-trace/ if you want binary traces.

devex: For a quick mitigation we could post-process responses with a sanitizer that strips U+2028/U+2029 and normalizes lone literal newlines inside values before JSON.parse. That would be non-invasive and reversible. Thoughts?

sam: Agree as a short-term fix. But we should also try to reproduce in floating-point variant to check if quantization path is causal. If it's only in int8 that's actionable.

anya-qa: I'll add an eval that runs 50k short toolcall prompts across int8, int8+alz, and fp16 and log the charset/unicode histogram on outputs.

maria: Also found one clear failure mode: when prefix ends with an open brace in the prompt and the model continues from a token that contains a multi-byte control char split across two subword tokens, our decoder postprocess currently doesn't reassemble into the proper codepoint before postprocessing. So we might be mangling UTF-8 sequence at token boundaries.

sam: Good catch. Can you test a decoder patch that re-checks incomplete multi-byte sequences across token boundaries and repairs them? If it reduces failures that's our root cause.

deploy-bot: canary-deploy raven-v3-int8-2026-03-19 triggered by @maria — status: running

maria: I pushed a temporary sanitizer behind a feature flag (sanitize_whitespace=True) and enabled it for 10% of canary traffic. Early numbers: parse failures dropped from 0.9% to 0.02% in that bucket.

anya-qa: Awesome. I'll let the large-run eval finish overnight and post a small regression heatmap tomorrow.

sam: Next actions: 1) Anya: run eval across quant variants; 2) Maria: prototype decoder-reassembly patch and run local fuzz; 3) Devex: add telemetry for control-codepoint frequency and token-boundary decode traces. We'll regroup once results arrive. :thumbsup:
